mapper.select: SELECT * FROM iot_data_parse_strategy WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM iot_data_parse_strategy WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY is_preset DESC, create_time ASC
SELECT * FROM iot_data_parse_strategy WHERE status = 1 AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iot_data_parse_strategy (name, source_type, description, status, app_scope, script_code, is_preset) VALUES (#{name}, #{sourceType}, #{description}, #{status}, #{appScope}, #{scriptCode}, IFNULL(#{isPreset}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE iot_data_parse_strategy SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE iot_data_parse_strategy SET last_run_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
